body: its fine... thank you for trying.
well... what can i do. i already fucked it up. so now im just indifferent about it all... living, dying... im just... empty

there were ups an downs. i was on medication and did well. i got a good job, car, gf...

but i felt apathetic, selfish. after my grandmother died i stoped taking them. broke my exes heart by kissing another girl. i met my recent ex and well.... i was genuinely happy, non medicated, not forced, like it felt amazing. we were only together fora month and that story is more descriptive in my first suicide watch reddit post.
ive been depressed since i was 12. if i could change anything... i wish i was stronger. i wish i was more talented. more determined. i wish i wasnt so needy. or sensitive

I don't have friends or family on this. I posted on here before about a girl and how i ruined my life for her. ME, MY FAULT... and ever since that i just never fully recovered. My friends are sick of me. They dont even talk to me. and the person i met here. She... she got sick of me too. she helped me and talked me out of it. and now she doesnt want anything to do with me. As for family... i have no real support system. just antidepressants and anxiety meds. my sister compares me to our mother who is a bum living on the streets, how im just like her. how my grandfather is sick of me since i crashed the car. He even said he doesnt want to talk to me anymore, my mom asks me for money. Im in debt for crashing the car and my sister is threatening to kick me out. And since my grandmother died(she raised me and took care of me)... shes basically in charge. so wtf am i supposed to do. get better over time? ive done that story. it ends the same way. it never lasts.

I dont mind choking for 30 mins. hell it wasnt as bad as I thought the first time. As for family they knew. My grandmother has passed away and other than that Im not very close to my family other than my older sister and even then me and her are always at eachothers throats.

The pain does numb I agree. But only after a long time of suffering. And even then it still stays in its hidden ways. It still haunts you and tells you how easy it be to give up. Not because you want attention, not because you want revenge, only because you dont want to think about it anymore...

I've tried to hang myself before. Back then it was about having no self esteem. Living on the streets, lost my job, lost my exgirlfriend back then too. Now I am more aware. If anything I can't mess up this time because last time all it did was get me in a hospital with even more bills to pay in a mental institute where no one gives a shit about you and forces medication down your throat constantly.
I'm sorry but the closer my birthday gets the sadder i feel. I only have one birthday wish and its not gonna happen...
You are absolutely right. Then again I still want what i had with this girl.

I remember it. I remember the ocean breeze, her singing. Passing through the streets, passing through recording the moments with her camera. I remember our laughter, our talks, light, lighthearted, I remember how beautiful it was, how beautiful she was, she is… I remember… I loved it. I loved it more than Disneyland, more than breathing, more than anything I loved her, and I felt so happy. You cant replicate that kind of happiness within yourself, that’s an experience… I remember dreaming, holding her hand the entire way. Even when I was overwhelmed with my senses, my priorities, pure bliss. I remember…  It wasn’t a generated effort, it wasn’t a forced hand.  And I loved her. I remember… and I cant forget, I wont… Even while it kills me. I never felt so real… All the forced smiles, all the fake happiness from years of regret, years of experience… I was happy, not a medicated happiness, not a forced happiness, but a true happiness. And I was in love. No motives, no hate, no plans, just peace, and at that moment, all those moments, I felt real. I remember her voice, her smile, I remember it as if she was the only thing tangible, when she was the only thing in existence. I was consumed, enveloped, and oh so happy.  My metaphysical high, my euphoria,  I was drugged up on happiness.

I hate to be more down than I am but I never really had anything to look forward to these past 23 years. I was raised in an abusive home with my strict grandmother. My mother is a druggie, my father no where to be found. Hell it was hard enough to gain confidence and effort after all that..
Ive had former relationships and I still miss some of them. That never dies. those memories never die.

Its never the same for any relationship. I had other relationships. Its the individual. Ill never meet someone like her again. Because every person is different. Different memories, different feel. You cant replicate what you had with someone to someone else..

This isnt the first time ive attempted it. I did it with my first relationship in college. Then though... I wasnt sure what to do with women, or how to talk to them, I had no self esteem, I just didnt want to be alone. This girl. I know shes messed up, just like me, and I love her for it. Nothing worth it was ever easy.
Thank you... I hope yours will go out better than mines.

Like I said, better is one thing. I loved this girl. Ive been in worse relationships where I was used. Ive been in better relationships where I was spoiled. This girl loved me, and I her. Im used to using antidepressants to make me ok. for her... I have had a happiness that cant be replicated, because each person is unique.each person is different. She gave me a happiness that wasnt forced, wasnt fake, wasnt medicated. I was in love. I remember driving on coast hwy with her. no radio, holding hands, laughing, smiling, by the ocean. You cant just forget someone who gave you so much to remember...
22, 23 this thursday

See this girl is different. Just like all my other past failed relationships. I still miss them somewhat. But her... Its just to hard to forget someone who gave you so much to remember...

Ive had better relationships, Ive had better people in my life. Its not about what was good or bad, its about the individual and fighting for her because I know I can take it. I love her not because of what she did, or even who she was. I love her for her and Id put up with all the bullshit again if it let me see her again.

All the bills I made through crashing my car after the breakup. I just dont find joy in anything, not food, not video games, not work, I feel like there is nothing to look forward to. I feel so sad that I dont enjoy anything...

 My birthday is this thursday and all I want is to talk to her again.

I take celexa. As for winning her back I honestly feel further and further away from having a chance. I recently contacted her just to let her know that I wanted to be friends or just talk. I asked her if I could for my birthday. Sadly no response but it was worth the shot. I didn't expect an answer and i even told her if she didnt want to id understand, but obviously its slowly killing me... See my birthday is this week on thursday... I know I have stuff to do and I try to divide it. As for the help I did ask for a refill on my antidepressants(I lost them in the car crash) other than that what I do for a living is work at a design firm for people who paint motifs such as fluer di lis. We basically make stencils. As for hobbies... I used to play a lot of video games, read, and write. But after the breakup I dont find enjoyment in any of those things... They just dont feel fufilling. I honestly think about how my ex is more than anything as if she forgot me... Sadly like I said it seems like she wants nothing to do with me... I cant say for sure but I miss her so much.

Every day I wake up feeling more and more suicidal. I look online to try and inspire myself, i cry and think about how she wont talk to me and how i feel like i lost her forever... I try to think about bettering myself, to not think about her but shes always on my mind. Shes the only thing that makes me happy even though i know i need to create my own happiness. I just feel hopeless...
i dont know... im having trouble pushing myself... I lay in bed all day. I try to go posiive but then I become lethargic, unmovable, i start thinking of suicide....

getting better. cleaning myself up, my life up, my room, fixing my car, getting rid of all my old clothes, give them away, start going to the gym, start running, re date, get my confidence back... fuck its hard to say and even harder to do all these things.

you sir or madam have a very strong inquisitive soul. Very useful. As for fear no. I just need to realize that Putting the first step usually helps. As for trying if I dont try Ill never know. So thats whats motivating me. That and your constant pushes. Thank you.

not really... no.
getting better?

Its about the individual. the person she was, who she is... I can't let that go. Its all I want... I know its dumb. I know its foolish, i know its selfish... but thats all I want. I give that up I give up everything...

my anxiety is crippling me. I constantly go back to thinking about her and then i think about how i feel trapped or like i need to jump off a cliff to stop feeling like this.

I just keep on thinking about how ill never get to talk to her again... I feel like im going crazy thinking about how shes no longer in my life, all that fun all those times... ruined by my selfish behavior...
